about: The Dalex house code and data each game assembles: house.asm (original), the logo bytes (copies of zx-assets house/dalex), the sting (copies of house-style/sting) and the zx-assets pattern player (for builds without their own). A game gets them with the template (src/house/), so the build needs no include path. Never edit the copies: re-copy from the source and update the sha256s; tests/unit/test_house.py checks every file against its source and both templates against each other.
owner_decision: house-style/README.md: lockup A for every game (2026-10-19)

dalex_sting.asm.note: copy: the AY sting song (zx-assets aypattern.py --one-shot, v3; house-style/sting/sting.json)

dalex_sting_beeper.asm.note: copy without its "org $8000" line (house.asm includes it inside MODULE house_beeper)

dalex_sting_steps.asm.note: copy: the beeper sting step table (beeper_build.py)

aypat.asm.note: copy: zx-assets pattern player, for builds without their own (HOUSE_HAVE_AYPAT not defined)

aycommon.asm.note: copy: zx-assets shared AY state (ay_shadow, ay_reset), included by aypat.asm

aypat_tables.asm.note: copy: zx-assets player tables (aypattern.tables_asm(), identical to the checked-in file)

footer-row.bin.note: copy: zx-assets house/dalex footer-row (sha-locked there: SHA256SUMS)

ident-core.bin.note: copy: zx-assets house/dalex ident-core (sha-locked there: SHA256SUMS)
